# catE-sovereignty-lint #40 baseline — KNOWN paid-Anthropic constructor sites.
#
# Each uncommented line below would be a PRE-EXISTING site of the banned paid
# per-token path (CLAUDE.md §3). The lint fails when the live count EXCEEDS the
# number of uncommented lines here, so this file is a BUDGET, not a list of
# identities: the grep cannot tell which hit belongs to which line, and a hit
# from anywhere — including a docstring that merely QUOTES the banned spelling
# — spends the same slot a real call site would.
#
# THE BUDGET IS NOW ZERO, and that is what makes the previous paragraph
# harmless. Measured 2026-09-20: the three sites this file used to name
# (ai_engine.py, process_batches_2_3.py, claims_extractor.py) were each
# remediated to the OAuth/CLI path and none of them has matched the grep for
# some time — but their lines were never deleted, though the file's own
# TODO said to delete them. Meanwhile the live count sat at 2, both of them
# docstrings quoting the ban. 2 quotes + 3 phantom slots meant one genuinely
# new paid call site could land and keep the step GREEN (simulated with a
# throwaway probe file: live count 3, baseline 3, 3 > 3 is false).
#
# Both docstrings were rewritten to describe the shape instead of spelling it
# (the rule the PII gate in .husky/pre-commit already states for its own
# pattern), the three remediated lines are gone, and the budget is 0. Any hit
# at all is now red — no arithmetic, nothing to keep in sync.
#
# TO ADD A LINE HERE you are asking for a paid per-token call site to be
# tolerated on main. It is not a formality: §3 bans the entity, not the
# spelling, and the sanctioned path is the `claude` CLI with
# CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, or the SDK constructed with an OAuth bearer.
#
# Discovered: 2026-06-11 guardian-of-guardians audit (domande-per-fable5 #40).
# Drained: 2026-09-20 (identity-vs-count audit).
